items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: He was on one or two sessions that we did in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: Let’s take the Rod Stewart thing for an example. Was he singing while the rhythm section was playing?
He was on one or two sessions that we did in Los Angeles. For the most part no. Someone else tracked his vocals for him.
Oh someone else sings so that you have a reference point or something?
